tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 7b (data EXPORT + the format registry) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 7) and spec.md (Import & Export) first. Phase 7a already built import (src/lib/import: parseQIF, parseCSV, detectCsvMapping, dedupeParsed, importTransactions). THIS task adds export + a modular format registry that unifies importers and exporters. Reuse: src/lib/import/ (parseQIF etc.), src/lib/crypto/ (deriveKey, encrypt, decrypt), src/lib/db/ models (Account, Transaction), src/stores/ (useAuthStore holds in-memory `repositories`; domain stores expose their loaded items), src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/export/** (create), src/lib/formats/** (create the registry), src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (add an export/backup/restore section — keep the existing delete-account danger zone and currency section), and new src/components/export/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/import/** (import it read-only), src/lib/crypto/**, auth/db, other stores/pages, routes, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies. Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it; drift fails it):
1. src/lib/export/index.ts:
   - export function exportQIF(account: Account, transactions: Transaction[]): string — emit valid QIF that Phase 7a parseQIF reads back to the SAME transactions: a `!Type:<mapped>` header, and per transaction D<date in DD/MM'YYYY>, T<amount with 2 decimals>, P<payee>, L<categoryId/category>, M<memo> when present, C* when cleared, then `^`. (Round-trip through parseQIF must preserve date/amount/payee/cleared.)
   - interface BackupData { version: number; accounts: Account[]; transactions: Transaction[]; categories: unknown[]; budgets: unknown[]; [k: string]: unknown }
   - export async function exportEncrypted(data: BackupData, passphrase: string): Promise<string> — serialize to JSON, derive a key from the passphrase via the crypto layer using a FRESH random salt, encrypt, and return a portable string envelope that embeds the salt + ciphertext (base64/JSON). The plaintext (e.g. payees) must NOT appear in the output.
   - export async function importEncrypted(blob: string, passphrase: string): Promise<BackupData> — read the salt, re-derive the key, decrypt, JSON.parse. A WRONG passphrase must REJECT (AES-GCM auth), not return garbage.
2. src/lib/formats/index.ts — a modular format registry so future formats (OFX) slot in without touching callers:
   - register the built-in formats: 'qif' (importer = a wrapper around parseQIF, exporter = exportQIF) and 'csv' (importer = a wrapper around parseCSV).
   - export function getImporter(id: string): Importer | undefined
   - export function getExporter(id: string): Exporter | undefined
   - export function listImportFormats(): string[] and export function listExportFormats(): string[] (listExportFormats must include 'qif').
   - define Importer/Exporter function types; keep it a simple registry map with a register() seam.
3. src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx — add a Data section: export a chosen account to QIF (download), export a full ENCRYPTED backup (passphrase prompt → download the blob), and RESTORE from an encrypted backup (upload blob + passphrase → importEncrypted → write the restored accounts/transactions/categories/budgets via `repositories` from useAuthStore, then refresh the stores). Use ui/button, ui/card. Trigger downloads client-side (Blob + object URL).

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. (Suite is deterministic; one run — do NOT loop it.) Write real Vitest tests for exportQIF (round-trip via parseQIF), the encrypted backup round-trip, and the registry.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the QIF emission format, the encrypted-backup envelope (salt handling), the registry design, and any follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures exactly; exportQIF must round-trip through Phase 7a parseQIF; encrypted output must be ciphertext (no plaintext payees) and reject a wrong passphrase; reuse the crypto/import layers (no new deps, do not reimplement crypto); keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (exportQIF round-trips through Phase 7a parseQIF preserving date/amount/payee/cleared; exportEncrypted is ciphertext at rest and importEncrypted restores with the right passphrase and rejects a wrong one; the format registry resolves a QIF exporter and QIF/CSV importers and lists 'qif'). The export module, format registry, and a SettingsPage export/backup/restore section exist. The Phase 7a/3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
